rationale: Designed a monotonic Volt-VAR curve that injects reactive power at low voltages (<0.95 pu) to mitigate voltage sag, absorbs reactive power at high voltages (>1.05 pu) to mitigate voltage swell, and has zero reactive power response near nominal voltage (0.98-1.02 pu). The curve respects inverter reactive power capabilities and maintains voltages within the 0.95-1.05 pu band for all timesteps.
